01 · Core visual direction

A studio review deck, not a coaching-class flyer.

Pune's animation institutes all look the same: neon gradients, stock students, "#1 institute" badges, logo walls. Arena JM Road wins by showing the thing nobody else shows clearly: real work, the process behind it, and the mentors who shape it.

Design philosophy

Let the work be the hero. Let the design behave like a production pipeline.

Every creative is framed like a shot in a 3D viewport: a calm charcoal stage, safe-frame brackets around the focal work, a single yellow highlight borrowed from the logo, small monospace production labels, and one clear next step. Energy comes from student work, not from effects.

What someone must feel in 3 seconds

Student, 16–21

"People like me make genuinely cool things here, and I could start even if I can't draw yet."

Parent, 38–55

"Structured, legitimate, safe. I can see what my child will learn and produce."

Switcher / creator

"Mature, specific, real critique. A credible route, not hype."

Personality
PracticalMentor-ledHonestCraft-proudBeginner-welcomingEnergetic, disciplined

The studio mentor in central Pune: shipped real projects, sits beside you at the pen tablet, tells you honestly what's working.

Premium cues
  • Real student work at full bleed
  • Process shown: sketch → blockout → render
  • Generous negative space (≥25%)
  • One accent, one focal point, one CTA
  • Dated, specific, verifiable proof

OUR CHARTER
How our placement support works
We don't promise jobs. Nobody honestly can. What we commit to is the work that gets you considered: a role-specific portfolio, mentor reviews at every milestone, mock interviews, and introductions to studios when your reel is ready.

Your part: attendance, deadlines and finished projects. Ours: honest feedback and a clear next step.

Ask us how outcomes are recorded before you enrol.
Placement assistance is subject to course completion, attendance and portfolio assessment. Outcomes vary by individual.

10 · Copy tone

A senior artist mentoring a junior.

Short, specific, confident, warm, never salesy. Students get direct and encouraging; parents get calm and factual; switchers get mature and outcome-led.

Write like this

Try the work before you choose the course.
From first sketch to final render. See how our students build it.
Can't draw yet? Most of our students couldn't either.Addresses the #1 beginner objection
Don't just play games. Build the levels.
Parents ask us 7 questions. Here are straight answers.
Weekend batch. Real briefs. Mentor review every week.
AI is a tool in the pipeline, not the artist. Learn both.
Every workstation. Its own pen tablet. JM Road, Pune.

Never this

#1 Pune's Best InstituteUnverifiable superlative, and it's on the live homepage today
100% Placement GuaranteedBanned claim
Turn your passion into professionEvery competitor says it
Unleash your creativity!!!Empty hype
Hollywood-level trainingImplies studio links we can't prove
Earn lakhs after 6 monthsSalary promise

11 · AI prompting system

AI makes the scene. Humans place the brand.

Works across GPT Image, Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, Reve, Leonardo, Canva AI and Runway. Never ask an image AI for the logo, the phone number or paragraphs, and never label AI output as student work.

ParameterArena behaviour
LightingMotivated: monitor glow, soft window daylight, one warm desk lamp. No neon rim-light or coloured gels.
CompositionEditorial asymmetry, one focal subject on a third, state where the empty text space goes.
Emotional framingFocus, flow, quiet pride, mentor–student trust. "It works!" moments, not staged excitement.
RealismPhotoreal people and campus; clean stylised 3D (clay, maquette, turntable) for concept art; never glossy AI plastic.
Camera35 / 50mm prime, f/2–2.8, eye-level or over-the-shoulder, documentary.
BackgroundCalm charcoal studio or warm off-white paper; blurred lab rows. Never sci-fi cityscapes.
Colour restraintNeutral world + one yellow #F2EC15 object at most; red only if essential.
Density1 subject, 1–2 props, 25%+ empty space.
ScreensBelievable viewports, node graphs, timelines; UI text soft and unreadable so the AI doesn't garble it.
InfographicsFlat vector, 2px line icons, keyframe-diamond markers, blank label areas, grid-aligned.

AI vs manual finishing

Generate with AI

  • Background scenes, lighting, mood
  • Concept props, maquettes, abstract VFX
  • Infographic base layouts, icon sets
  • Carousel background series
  • Festival craft-style artwork

Always finish manually (Canva / Figma / PS)

  • Arena logo: the real file
  • Headline, body, bullets, CTA buttons
  • Phone, website, address, footer strip
  • Real student work, credited
  • Real campus + faculty photos
  • Review quotes + live-checked rating
12 · Claims, compliance & anti-patterns

If a design needs a banned claim, the design is wrong.

These override every aesthetic decision. Aligned with ASCI expectations for education advertising: claims must be substantiated, placement claims need verifiable data.

Never publish
Use instead
"100% placement" / "guaranteed job"
"Placement assistance: ask how it works"
"#1" / "Pune's best institute"
"Rated by our students on Google" (number live-checked)
Salary figures, "earn lakhs"
"Explore roles in animation, VFX, gaming and design"
"UGC-recognised B.Voc degree" (unverified)
Omit until confirmed in writing by the client
"AI-proof career" / "only AI institute"
"Fundamentals + AI-assisted workflows"
AI art captioned as student work
Real, consented, credited student work only
AI people as students, alumni or faculty
Real people with consent, or text-only verbatim reviews
Recruiter logo walls as a promise
Named, dated, consented alumni stories
"Only 2 seats left!"
"Next batch starts [real date]"
Minors identifiable without consent
Guardian consent on file, or over-shoulder shots

Visual anti-patterns

What the category overuses
UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY

Neon glow on cyan/purple gradients

100%PLACEMENT

"100% placement" / "#1" badges

Stock students pointing at laptops

VR headsets, astronauts, robots, floating heads

ADMISSION OPEN!!!

Red/yellow slabs: shop-banner look

ARENA 3D

Chrome, bevelled or 3D text

Recruiter / software logo walls

GL1TCH

Glitch, lens flare, light trails

Also never: copyrighted characters or look-alikes (Marvel, Disney, Pixar, anime, game franchises), Western stock models as Arena students, clip-art, emoji as icons, centred paragraphs longer than 3 lines, naming or mocking competitors in ads.
